reviewedBaseline.sizeBudgetRationale: Issues #306 and #308 intentionally add TSDoc to the published TypeScript source tree, increasing package source bytes without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #319 adds horizon-qualified empty-snapshot discovery to insights, growing compiled JS/d.ts source bytes with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #314 adds native no-replay write interruption classification, shared cause-chain helpers, and operator logging for operation_status_unknown, including definitive-status preservation for malformed non-2xx and truncated success bodies with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #332 adds durable-secret fail-safe recovery, Partner response-shape validation, and exact-secret log redaction for newly minted application keys with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #270 adds Streamable HTTP eval coverage plus a standalone HTTP listen-host option so evals can bind loopback-only, increasing CLI/config source and public docs with no new runtime dependencies. The aws-sdk group bump (@aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner 3.1103.0 -> 3.1119.0, with @smithy/types realigned 4.16.1 -> 4.17.2 to keep the reviewed command/type boundary on a single version) grows the reviewed AWS transitive graph slightly with no new direct dependencies. Issue #344 upgrades @backblaze-labs/b2-sdk 0.3.0 -> 0.4.0 so Partner create/reserve tools consume the SDK's single-object durable-secret responses without adding runtime dependencies; review hardening adds Partner successful-response recovery capture, allow-list projections, legacy sink replay, and documented release-age/no-replay evidence. Issue #166 adds MCP workflow prompts, safe-integer bounded prompt argument schemas, and the generated prompt contract surface, growing compiled JS/d.ts source bytes with no new runtime dependencies. Issue #367 expands tool descriptions, generated contracts, and README/LobeHub tool text for TDQS behavior, parameter, and usage-guidance coverage with no new runtime dependencies or package entries. Issue #363 adds credential-free discovery routing and HTTP hardening without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #372 reorganizes published docs into the harness-engineering taxonomy while retaining one-release compatibility aliases for old public doc paths, increasing packed entry count without changing runtime dependencies. Issue #379 adds a root PRIVACY.md privacy policy for directory submissions, adding one packed entry without changing runtime dependencies.

@aws-sdk/client-s3.purpose: Permanent primary AWS S3 SDK dependency for B2's S3-compatible s3_* data-plane tools and usage-report object reads.
@aws-sdk/client-s3.policy: Must remain isolated behind src/s3/aws-sdk-adapter.ts; tool handlers must not construct AWS clients directly.

@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.purpose: Permanent primary presigning dependency for B2 S3-compatible GetObject, PutObject, and UploadPart bearer URLs.
@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner.policy: Must remain isolated behind src/s3/aws-sdk-adapter.ts; presigned URL tool handlers use the repository-owned adapter contract.

@backblaze-labs/b2-sdk.purpose: Primary Backblaze B2 transport and public SDK boundary for native B2, Partner/Groups, raw, S3 helper, and simulator-backed tests.
@backblaze-labs/b2-sdk.policy: Must remain a stable npm release pinned exactly in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.

@smithy/types.purpose: Public AWS/Smithy command and streaming-body type boundary for the permanent S3 peer adapter.
@smithy/types.policy: Must stay pinned to the version resolved through the reviewed AWS SDK dependency set.

@modelcontextprotocol/server.purpose: Stable MCP server v2 runtime for stdio and Streamable HTTP handling.
@modelcontextprotocol/server.policy: Use public v2 server exports only; do not add the monolithic v1 SDK.

jose.purpose: JOSE (JWKS/JWT) verification for the OAuth resource server local access-token path; performs JWK import and JWS signature verification for RS256/ES256/EdDSA.
jose.policy: Exact-pinned and asymmetric algorithms only. jose is a new production dependency: it was previously present only in the dev tree (via the @modelcontextprotocol/client devDependency), so a production install did not include it before. It adds exactly one package to the production closure (jose has no runtime dependencies of its own), which is why the reviewed total production package count moved to 48.

opossum.purpose: Circuit breaker runtime for bounded provider calls.
opossum.policy: Exact-pinned because major/runtime support changes can affect the Node engine floor.

pino.purpose: Structured server logging with existing secret-redaction policy.
pino.policy: No wrapper logging package may be added without review.

zod.purpose: MCP tool input schemas supplied to the server runtime.
zod.policy: Schema package additions require review; do not duplicate validation stacks.

process-warning.purpose: Reviewed pnpm migration transitive runtime package reached through pino warning paths.
process-warning.policy: Pinned by pnpm-lock.yaml after the npm-to-pnpm lock conversion moved the reviewed runtime graph from process-warning 5.0.0 to 5.1.0.

real-require.reason: Pinned production transitive packages currently require both pino's helper and thread-stream's nested helper.
